edition.title: What remains
edition.subtitle: Bitcoin’s unspent outputs, block by block

scenes.title: Field
scenes.purpose: The whole history seen from beyond its newest block: the edge glows in front and the past recedes to the horizon.

scenes.title: A cell
scenes.purpose: Arrive beside one column at the newest edge and hold: 214 outputs of about 1 BTC, each division one output.

scenes.title: Time
scenes.purpose: The camera holds still while 1,200 real blocks replay: the cell loses outputs and new columns rise beyond the edge.

scenes.title: Readings: outputs
scenes.purpose: Height and colour by the number of outputs in each cell, with the app’s amount labels.

scenes.title: Readings: value
scenes.purpose: Height by the number of outputs, colour by the BTC they hold: the band beyond the 5 BTC label lights up.

scenes.title: The field at the newest block
scenes.purpose: The opening composition at its dataset's newest block, breathing slowly.

scenes.title: Seventeen years
scenes.purpose: Sampled block states from the genesis block to the newest, about 2,000 blocks apart.

scenes.title: The ridge rises
scenes.purpose: Sampled block states, 2023 into 2024: the rows of a few hundred satoshis fill.

scenes.title: A day over the field
scenes.purpose: Time of day from sunrise to night over the same view; the data does not change.

scenes.title: Earth
scenes.purpose: The Earth look: the same data as an atlas, sea to the horizon.

scenes.title: A cell
scenes.purpose: The column of the film seen from beyond the newest block, above the field against the sky.

scenes.title: After 1,200 blocks
scenes.purpose: The last frame of Time: the cell holds 94 outputs; new columns stand to its right.

scenes.title: The map: the whole chain
scenes.purpose: The whole chain from above, a strip across the frame with every year along it; the film adds a year axis below.

scenes.title: The map: every amount
scenes.purpose: From above over the last five years, every amount row in view; the film adds an amount scale up the side.

scenes.title: The first line
scenes.purpose: Low along the row of about 50 BTC outputs of 2009 and 2010: 33,094 never spent at block 969,652.

scenes.title: Round amounts
scenes.purpose: Over blocks 300,000 to 520,000 (2014 to 2018) in the Outputs look: the rows around 0.01, 0.1, 1 and 10 BTC each hold at least twice as many outputs as any of the two rows on either side.

scenes.title: The ridge
scenes.purpose: The ridge of outputs worth a few hundred satoshis that rises from 2023, in Golden hour.

scenes.title: Towers
scenes.purpose: Cell 15141:222 in Daylight: 35 outputs of exactly 1,000 BTC from blocks 969,024 to 969,087, about ten hours.

scenes.title: The newest edge
scenes.purpose: Along the newest edge at block 969,652, toward the 1 BTC band.

scenes.title: A cell, from above
scenes.purpose: Above cell 15150:803 at the film's anatomy of a cell: 64 blocks, one amount row, 214 outputs.

scenes.title: From above: Pulse
scenes.purpose: The whole chain from above in Pulse while blocks 969,652 to 970,852 replay; each flash is a spend, placed at the year its coins were made. Static link: the starting composition; press Play.

scenes.title: From above: the film's look
scenes.purpose: The recent field from above in the BitcoinTimelapse.com look while the same 1,200 blocks replay. Static link: the starting composition; press Play.
